skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the role, characteristics, and structure of agricultural investment projects; manage project risks and investments.
Conduct market research and identify investment opportunities in agriculture.
Estimate project investment costs, analyze investment effectiveness, and make investment decisions.
Develop business plans and strategies for agricultural projects.
Identify and mitigate risks in agricultural investment projects.
Make informed decisions based on financial and market analysis.
Work independently and take responsibility for project tasks.
Collaborate effectively in group projects and presentations.
Analyze and solve complex problems in agricultural business.
Effectively communicate project ideas and findings.
Continuously improve knowledge and skills through self-study.
